text:
rachel.partnerships: Kickoff: AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace listing. Need demo tenant owner, AMI regions, SKU packaging, and legal checklist. Can we confirm owners?

devin.cloudops: I can own demo tenant bootstrap and AMI seeding. Which regions are must-have for launch?

anya.product: Product prefers visible Trial-14d SKU + Standard monthly SKU. Trials should keep data 30 days post-expiry then auto-delete unless upgraded.

omar.legal: Note: EU requires localized EULA + DPA link in SKU metadata. Also need support contact and export-control statement.

rachel.partnerships: Plan suggestion: seed AMIs in us-east-1, eu-west-1, asia-east2; create demo tenants per cloud; publish two SKUs. Omar, can you draft EULA addendum by EOD Wed?

omar.legal: I can. Need final SKU descriptions and whether telemetry is opt-in during trial.

anya.product: Telemetry is opt-out for trial, we will call that out in the UI and SKU notes. Will drop SKU docs by Tue AM.

devin.cloudops: Bootstrap snippet (will run once creds in vault):
```bash
# example: copy AMI to target region
aws ec2 copy-image --source-region us-west-2 --source-image-id ami-0abcd1234 --region us-east-1
# create demo account (org)
aws organizations create-account --email demo+aws@example.com --account-name redwood-demo-aws
```
I need service account keys for GCP and Azure SP JSON in the secure vault.

rachel.partnerships: I'll upload keys to vault and add marketing asks: hero image + 60-word blurb. First line <80 chars.

deploy-bot: Staging AMI copy queued: job jb-90011. Will post completion.

devin.cloudops: Smoke checklist after seed: 1) demo auth check 2) sample generate <300ms p95 3) billing webhook receives meter event. Will post results.

rachel.partnerships: Timeline: aim for assets + demo tenants by Thu EOD for legal/marketing review on Fri. Any blockers?

omar.legal: No blockers pending draft EULA + SKU text.

anya.product: On it.

devin.cloudops: Starting AMI job tonight.

rachel.partnerships: Thanks all :thumbsup:
